subject: Consumption health review and staged uplift proposal
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@clearview.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-30T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Consumption health review and staged uplift proposal

Hi Nora —

Thanks again for the time last week. I pulled together a short usage snapshot for Clearview covering July–August and a first-pass recommendation for a staged uplift given the recent spike in embedding + chat tokens. See attached: usage_summary_aug2027.xlsx (tabbed: daily tokens, model mix, latency percentiles).

Quick highlights:
- 3.2x token growth month-over-month driven by automated ingestion and nightly re-embedding jobs.
- Current hosted plan shows 95th latency at ~210 ms for chat generation; peaks at 380 ms during batch windows.
- Unit economics indicate ~18% higher cost per 1M tokens vs. a dedicated pool with basic prefix caching enabled.

Suggested next steps:
1) 2-week dedicated burst (reserved capacity) to evaluate latency tail and warm KV cache.
2) Staged commit: 3-month trial uplift (1.5x committed) -> 6-month commit at 2.5x if ROI targets met.
3) Shared MAP draft and ROI recap from our side after you confirm the test window.

Would you be available for a 30-min alignment this week to lock the test window and go over the ROI assumptions? I'm flexible Wed/Thu mornings PT.

Attachments: usage_summary_aug2027.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Nora Patel <nora@clearview.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearview.ai
Date: 2027-09-02T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption health review and staged uplift proposal

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the summary and the quick read on tokens. A couple of clarifying items before we tee up a call: 

1) Can you provide a concise ROI calc that maps our current spend to the proposed committed tiers (1.5x and 2.5x)? I want to present a clear delta to finance.
2) Our security team will want SLA language around latency. For the dedicated burst, can you guarantee 95th percentile < 200ms for our chat workloads, or will that be best-effort during the two-week window?
3) For procurement, please include any standard contract change implications (term changes, early termination optics).

If you can share the ROI PDF and a draft MAP before EOD Friday, I can loop legal/procurement and get tentative availability.

— Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Product, Clearview AI
nora@clearview.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@clearview.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-06T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption health review and staged uplift proposal

Nora — looping in the ROI recap as requested. Attaching the one-pager that converts trunk spend into committed tiers and shows modeled savings with prefix/KV cache and a 7% improvement from quantized embeddings inference. See attached: roi_recap_clearview_q3.pdf (pdf).

Short summary from the model:
- Baseline (no commit): $28,400 / month (observed average Aug).
- 1.5x staged commit (trial): $39,600 / month with estimated token unit cost reduction of ~12% after autoscaling and caching optimizations.
- 2.5x steady commit: $66,000 / month with projected unit cost reduction of ~22% and improved latency due to pinned capacity.
- Estimated 6-month payback on engineering spend to migrate nightly jobs off peak windows and enable more aggressive caching rules.

Latency & guarantees: during a dedicated pool (reserved) our SREs will configure pinned workers; realistically we can target 95th < 200 ms for the chat generation path assuming the model variant stays the same and sequence lengths remain within current 95th percentile. I want to be clear: formal SLA language needs to be in the contract (service level & remediation) — we can propose SLA terms for Dedicated in the MAP.

Proposed practical next steps:
- Run two-week dedicated burst (production traffic mirrored) starting week of Sep 20.
- If 95th <= 200 ms and unit cost reduction meets model, move to 3-month uplift commit as a trial.

Attachments: roi_recap_clearview_q3.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Ben Carter
Customer Success - Renewals | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Nora Patel <nora@clearview.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-07T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption health review and staged uplift proposal

Nora / team —

Thanks for the prompt review. I attached a draft MAP and a short performance test plan to structure the two-week burst: MAP_draft_v3.docx, performance_test_plan.md. Key contractual notes:

- Term: propose a 12-month master amendment with an initial 3-month trial uplift clause (auto converts to committed tier if KPI pass).
- Pricing: trial uplift at 1.5x committed consumption pricing; conversion to 2.5x at agreed milestone.
- Cancellation: 30-day pro-rated exit during trial; standard termination thereafter.

Operationally:
- Two-week dedicated burst: Redwood engineers will coordinate a mirrored traffic pass (non-destructive reads for nightly jobs) and collect latency + cache warm metrics.
- SRE onboarding call on Day -3 of the burst to validate traffic mirroring and metrics ingestion.

Related links: DocuSign MAP draft (will share link once internal review complete) and HubSpot deal RW-3742 updated with MAP tasks.

Let me know if we should add a short addendum for data residency (if procurement needs it) — we can template the language.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@clearview.ai>, procurement@clearview.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final proposal: two-week burst & MAP next steps (RW-3742)

Nora / Procurement —

Following up with a consolidated proposal and attachments. TL;DR: we recommend starting the two-week dedicated burst the week of Sep 20; if the burst meets the KPI (95th <= 200 ms and unit cost reduction >= 10%), Clearview can elect to move to the 3-month trial uplift at 1.5x with an automatic evaluation point at month 3 for conversion to 2.5x.

Attachments included:
- usage_summary_aug2027.xlsx (xlsx)
- roi_recap_clearview_q3.pdf (pdf)
- MAP_draft_v3.docx (docx)
- performance_test_plan.md (md)

Requested asks:
1) Confirm a preferred start date for the two-week burst (we suggested Sep 20).
2) Confirm any legal/procurement constraints that would prevent a staged commit flow (term length, auto-convert language).
3) Provide preferred signers for the MAP so we can pre-populate DocuSign.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min alignment with SRE, CS (Ben), and Sales Ops (Lauren) to kick off the test run and walk through the MAP. Proposed times: Sep 14–15 between 9–11am PT.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
